```{r}
#| label: setup
#| include: false
library(eco230r)
```

## Purpose

Use this short lab to confirm that you can edit an R value, run code, and render
a Quarto document in Posit Cloud.

## 1) Personalize the certificate

Replace the example values below. Enter the last four digits of your student ID
as a number, your current comfort level from 0 to 10, and your name as text.

```{r}
my_id <- 1234
my_comfort <- 5
my_name <- "Your Name"
```

## 2) Validate your setup

Run this code. If it reports an error, confirm `my_id` contains four digits and
ask for help before continuing.

```{r}
my_validation <- validate(my_id)
my_validation
```

## 3) Render your certificate

Let it be known that **`r my_name`** successfully edited and ran an ECO 230
Quarto document. Their current comfort level is **`r my_comfort` out of 10**.

```{r}
#| echo: false
#| fig-align: left
#| out-width: "45%"
knitr::include_graphics("media/images/Hats_Off.jpg")
```

The setup check returned: *"`r my_validation`"*

## Completion checklist

- [ ] I replaced all three example values.
- [ ] I ran the validation code successfully.
- [ ] I rendered `Lab_01_IP.pdf`.
- [ ] I can locate the PDF in the Files pane.
